name: Projected Distinguishing Range / Log Shattering (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter admits a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the half-interval class $\mathcal I_n$, projected distinguishing range is $n-1$, while log shattering is $\log_2 n$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the trivial class $\mathcal T_n=\{\emptyset,[n]\}$, log shattering is $\log_2(n+1)$, while projected distinguishing range is $1$.
proof: The two canonical value calculations give unbounded gaps in the two directions.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Projected Distinguishing Range and Log Shattering of Half-Intervals and Trivial Concepts.
